title: Ecohydrological characteristics of biocrusts explain divergent responses of biocrusts and grasses to rainfall reduction
content:
Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.


Abstract

Drylands are mainly structured by both vascular plants and biological soil crusts (biocrusts), the latter often regarded as a self-organizing component of these ecosystems. Yet how the covers of these two components respond jointly to rainfall variability remains unclear—a critical gap for predicting future dryland resilience and carbon–water dynamics. To that end, we conducted a 4-year rainfall reduction experiment (−75%, −50%, −25% and control) in a semi-arid grassland with a large number of replicates, allowing a robust assessment of ecosystem responses under natural conditions. We found that grass cover responded mainly to rainfall reduction treatments, showing consistent declines due to their dependence on water input. Biocrust cover was more resilient to rainfall reduction but strongly promoted by years with more frequent rainfall events, reflecting their poikilohydric nature. Ecohydrological characteristics of biocrusts—specifically their rainfall thresholds for minimum carbon gain (carbon-balancing rainfall size) and maximum water absorption (maximum usable rainfall size)—explained these divergent responses by mediating water availability. Synthesis. Our findings show that biocrusts mediate grass water supply by intercepting a significant fraction of rainfall; failing to account for this hydrological interaction leads to a biased overestimate of plant-available water. This underscores the need to integrate biocrust-plant interactions into experimental and modelling frameworks to improve predictions of dryland ecosystem sustainability under climate change.

摘要

旱区主要由维管植物和生物土壤结皮(生物结皮)构成，后者通常被认为是这些生态系统的自我组织部分。然而，这两个生物组分的盖度如何共同响应降雨变化仍不清楚——这是预测未来旱区恢复力和碳水动态的一个关键认知空白。 为此，我们在一个半干旱草原开展了一项为期四年且有大量重复样方的减雨实验(-75%、-50%、-25%和对照)，从而能对自然条件下的生态系统响应进行稳健的评估。 我们发现，由于依赖水分输入，草本盖度主要响应减雨处理，表现一致性的下降。生物结皮盖度对减雨处理具有更强的适应性，但在降雨事件更频繁的年份会显著增加，这反映了其变水生物的特性。生物结皮的生态水文特征——特别是其获得最小碳吸收的降雨阈值(碳平衡降雨量)和最大水分吸收阈值(最大可利用降雨量)——通过调节水分有效性解释了两者的差异性响应。 我们的研究结果表明，生物结皮通过截留很大一部分降水调节草本植物的水分供给；未能考虑这种水文相互作用会导致对植物可利用水分的高估。这突显了将生物结皮-植物相互作用纳入实验和模型框架的必要性，以提高对气候变化下旱区生态系统可持续性的预测。
